input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: Section 5(a) does impose a minimum monthly spend on Client for Hosting and Support Services (a take-or-pay floor), so the preferred position (no minimum commitment, pay only for usage/ordered Services) is not met. It does, however, sit at the fallback on its material terms: (i) the commitment is bounded by a 12-month term — Section 13 fixes the term at one year, and each automatic renewal is a fresh one-year term that Client can stop on thirty (30) days' notice of intent not to renew, so there is no multi-year lock-in; (ii) Client has an unconditional exit on roughly a month's notice — Section 14 lets Client elect to terminate at any time, with services (and therefore the minimums) running only to the last day of the month following the notice month; and (iii) there is no shortfall penalty, liquidated damages or accelerated-minimum mechanic anywhere — the floor is simply a monthly fee that ceases on termination, so nothing punitive needs converting to a true-up. This is comfortably outside walk-away territory (multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right). Minor points noted but not redlined: the exit is a full termination rather than a partial reduction and can run to ~59 days rather than exactly 30; there is no express true-up credit; Section 14's "Subject to Section 4" and Section 6's reference to "minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4" (the minimums are in Section 5) are loose cross-references worth tidying, and Section 6 bars Client from contesting or obtaining backup for the minimum fees. Separately, the credit-report sourcing obligation in Section 3(i) applies only where Client uses the Interface and is not a volume commitment; the Section 4 support-availability period is a Vendor commitment to us and is fine.
